faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I withdraw the collected funds?
faq.a1: Once the campaign is complete, the organizer can request a withdrawal to their bank card. Transfers usually take 1-3 business days.
faq.q2: What if the campaign doesn't reach its goal?
faq.a2: If the campaign doesn't reach its goal by the deadline, the organizer can either extend the deadline or close it and withdraw the collected amount.
faq.q3: Which cards and payment systems are supported?
faq.a3: We support Visa and Mastercard from anywhere in the world, as well as fast payments via Apple Pay and Google Pay.

trust.title: Trust & Safety
trust.intro: We make sure every donation reaches its destination. Here is how we protect our platform from fraud:
trust.verificationText: Every organizer has the option to pass an identity verification procedure before withdrawing funds. Verified campaigns receive a special trust badge.
trust.moderationText: Our system blocks suspicious activity, and our moderation team reviews user reports 24/7.
trust.reportingText: If a campaign seems suspicious, you can report it. Campaigns with multiple reports are temporarily frozen until the organizer provides supporting documents.

contact.title: Contact Support
contact.desc: Have questions or suggestions? Write to us, and we will get back to you shortly.
contact.successMsg: Thank you! Your message has been sent successfully. We will contact you soon.

terms.title: Terms of Use & About Us
terms.aboutText: RazomFund is a collective fundraising platform created for volunteers, public figures, and private initiatives. Our goal is to provide fast and transparent fundraising for charity, military needs, or shared goals.
terms.commissionText: We support transparency. The platform commission is only 1% of each donation. Secure systems are used for payments, including Stripe, with support for fast payments via Apple Pay and Google Pay.
terms.rulesText: Organizers commit to providing accurate information about the goals of their campaigns and guarantee the intended use of funds. Donors can make transfers securely, in a few clicks, and without mandatory registration.
